messages:
alyssa: heads up — nightly eval alert: structured promptset silence rate jumped from 0.3% -> 9.1% on rw-7b-v2-int8-packedkv. posting logs and a short writeup, need triage.
omar: :eyes: link to the eval dashboard?
alyssa: https://internal.redwood/evals/nightly/2026-03-19/rw-7b-v2-int8-packedkv — metric is `silence_rate_structured` (we added it last quarter). graph attached in dashboard shows spike aligned with last deploy.
carmen: which deploy rolled? I saw a small runtime change yesterday for packedKV stride optimization.
alyssa: deploy-bot: deploy rw-runtime v2.18 -> completed at 3287651200 (yesterday). change: packed-kv stride packing -> new layout for odd-length batches (saves memory).
ben: eval-bot: nightly run summary:
```
model: rw-7b-v2-int8-packedkv
promptset: structured-promptset-v3
baseline silence_rate: 0.003
current silence_rate: 0.091
median latency: +2% (ok)
failing_examples: 412 / 4500
sample_failure:
--- prompt ---
{"system": "{\"format\":\"json\"}", "user": "List appliances as JSON array"}
--- model output ---
""
```
omar: interesting — failures biased toward prompts whose system message is a JSON-only single tokenized chunk (short seq).
alyssa: I ran a quick diff between v2.17 (pre-change) and v2.18: the only runtime change correlated was the stride packing. also saw a tokenizer micropatch pushed last week but that landed on a different branch.
sasha: could int8 PTQ + new packing interact? if KV offsets get misaligned we might be reading previous cache tokens incorrectly, leading to immediate EOS generation.
carmen: repro locally with minimal prompt?
alyssa: local repro attached: exit code 0 but empty string returned for many runs. run script:
```
python repro.py --model rw-7b-v2-int8-packedkv --prompt-file repro_prompts.jsonl
```
result: 23/50 prompts returned ""
ben: I instrumented the runtime: noticed that for affected requests, the KV write offset was off by 1 *element* for sequence lengths that are multiples of 8 after packing. reads then pull a zero vector into attention keys for first decode step. that zeros attention -> model emits EOS.
omar: root cause hypothesis: the new packed-kv layout introduced an off-by-one element stride when batch lengths aligned to packing block size (8). coupled with int8 quantized kernels that don't check bounds strictly, the erroneous read returns zeros instead of the correct kv slice.
sasha: corroborating: int8 GEMM implementation clamps reads but zero-fill happens for out-of-range. non-quantized fp16 path preserved values so we didn't see issue in dedicated fp16 models.
alyssa: minimal root-cause summary: runtime packing change + quantized kernel bounds behavior -> KV read offset corruption for certain prompt length patterns -> immediate EOS/silence on structured short-system prompts.
carmen: mitigation options?
ben: short-term: revert the stride change in rw-runtime v2.18 for all int8-packed model families (fast rollback). mid-term: add bounds checks in int8 kernels and add unit tests for all packing alignments. long-term: expand nightly eval to include synthetic length-edge promptset.
alyssa: agreed. propose actions: 1) rollback v2.18 for int8-packed families (owner: eng-runtime) 2) add canary gating in deploy pipeline: block if silence_rate_structured > 1% on canary runs (owner: eng-ml + eng-platform) 3) patch int8 kernel to panic/log if out-of-bounds reads observed (owner: eng-infra) 4) add synthetic promptset to CI/nightly (owner: eng-ml) 5) postmortem doc + customer comms checklist (owner: product).
omar: I'll kick off rollback. deploy-bot: rollback request queued for rw-runtime v2.17 -> initiated.
deploy-bot: rollback completed at 3287653400, canary cluster switched.
ben: after rollback, eval-bot re-run on canary: silence_rate_structured -> 0.002. samples restored. metrics look back to baseline.
alyssa: great. next steps: ben and omar to implement a small regression test that generates structured system-only prompts (>=3 tokenizers patterns) and asserts non-empty output. add to pre-deploy canary tests. carmen to spec kernel bounds unit test. sasha to review PTQ kernel clamp behavior and propose fail-fast instead of silent zero-fill.
sasha: will do, target PRs by EOD tomorrow.
carmen: I'll file the kernel ticket and start the unit-test scaffold.
ben: creating change request: RD-3487 "packed-kv stride off-by-one: enforce bounds and add regression tests". linking to thread.
alyssa: customer impact assessment: internal logs show no external escalations; some QA customers on sandbox reported flaky structured-json features this morning — ops notified. product will draft a short note if public-facing behavior observed.
alyssa: final notes (root cause writeup):
- timeline: packed-kv stride change deployed 3287651200 -> spike observed in nightly run 3287654321
- cause: stride packing + int8 kernel silent zero-fill -> KV misread -> immediate EOS for short-structured prompts
- impact: ~9% silence on structured promptset v3, ~0.09% overall traffic impact (low), but reproducible on canary
- mitigations: rollback completed, hotfix plan (kernel bounds + unit tests), gating rule added to canary pipeline, synthetic promptset added to nightly
- owners: eng-runtime (rollback + test infra), eng-infra (kernel fix), eng-ml (eval additions), eng-platform (deploy gating), product (customer comms)
alyssa: tagging owners: @omar @ben @carmen @sasha — please ack and update tickets. :white_check_mark:
omar: ack, already on rollback and will follow up with PR for packing layout test.
ben: ack, will push the canary test and RD-3487 today.
sasha: ack, will open kernel PR with logging by EOD.
carmen: ack, creating unit test and ticket.
allyssa: thanks everyone. I'll convert this thread into the formal postmortem doc and link to RD-3487 and canary logs.
deploy-bot: note: canary gating rule added: block deploys if silence_rate_structured > 0.01 on canary-run.
alyssa: closing thread; will keep updates in the postmortem doc.
